info.title: RangeWatch API
info.description: Species-keyed MLOps service for MaxEnt species distribution models: incremental GBIF/iNaturalist ingestion, conditional retraining, model lineage, map-layer descriptors (titiler / pg_tileserv) and automated bulletins.

get.description: Resolve free text to canonical GBIF backbone taxon keys, enriched with iNat metadata.

post.description: Enqueue the incremental-fetch / conditional-retrain pipeline (full run if new).
Project the current model onto registered climate scenarios (no retraining).
Refit the current model on the independent cross-check climate stack (e.g. CHELSA).
Project the current model at high resolution (e.g. 30″) inside a region.

put.description: Save a user-reviewed polygon. Confirming it unlocks (re)training.

get.description: Paginated occurrence list for table views (map layers use pg_tileserv vector tiles).

put.description:
Update the severity weights/priors and re-weight the current model's components
(no retraining; returns null if no model exists yet).

get.description: All model versions, newest first, with full reproducibility metadata.
Live job list for a species (or all jobs): replaces client polling while connected.

200.description: text/event-stream of `jobs` events; each `data:` line is a JSON array of JobOut (newest first, same as GET /jobs), sent on connect and on change

method.title: Method
method.description: Method actually used, e.g. target_group_order, buffer_500km

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why target-group background was not used, if it was requested

crosscheck_version.title: Crosscheck Version
crosscheck_version.description: Independent climate stack used for the climate-data cross-check

n_dropped.title: N Dropped
n_dropped.description: Training points without data in the alternative stack

suitability_rank_correlation.title: Suitability Rank Correlation
suitability_rank_correlation.description: Spearman ρ of the two models' suitability at the training points

ClimateCrossCheckOut.title: ClimateCrossCheckOut
ClimateCrossCheckOut.description:
The model version refitted on an independent climate source (same training points,
feature classes, regularisation and CV seed) and compared with the original.

flag_rule.title: Flag Rule
flag_rule.description: When this diagnostic flags a cell as extrapolation

candidate_flagged_fraction.title: Candidate Flagged Fraction
candidate_flagged_fraction.description: Share of the candidate invasion zone flagged by this diagnostic

n_cv_folds.title: N Cv Folds
n_cv_folds.description: Spatial CV folds used for the MOP/Shape/AOA thresholds

mop_percentage.title: Mop Percentage
mop_percentage.description: % of closest reference points averaged by MOP

aoa_weights.title: Aoa Weights
aoa_weights.description: Predictor weights of the AOA distance (permutation importance, max = 1)

consensus_land_area_km2.title: Consensus Land Area Km2
consensus_land_area_km2.description: Land area flagged by exactly 0, 1, …, 5 of the diagnostics

candidate_consensus_ok_fraction.title: Candidate Consensus Ok Fraction
candidate_consensus_ok_fraction.description: Share of the candidate zone flagged by none of the diagnostics

candidate_consensus_majority_fraction.title: Candidate Consensus Majority Fraction
candidate_consensus_majority_fraction.description: Share of the candidate zone flagged by at least 3 of the 5 diagnostics

top_combinatorial_variables.title: Top Combinatorial Variables
top_combinatorial_variables.description: exDet most influential covariates where NT2 > 1 (novel combinations)

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] of the projected region

consensus.description: This region's own diagnostic-consensus overlay (null for legacy)

HiresLayer.title: HiresLayer
HiresLayer.description: Regional high-resolution projection of the same model (no retraining).

extrapolation.description: MESS < 0 mask; always offered as an overlay with any projection

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Advanced extrapolation diagnostics as map views: exdet, mop, shape, aoa and consensus (empty for models trained before they existed)

consensus_overlay.description: Haze overlay graded by how many diagnostics flag extrapolation; an alternative to the MESS < 0 overlay

scenarios_available.title: Scenarios Available
scenarios_available.description: Scenarios registered for the model's bioclim version (projected or not)

hires_available.title: Hires Available
hires_available.description: Resolution of the model's high-resolution stack, if one is registered

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Mark as user-reviewed; required before training

train.title: Train
train.description: Enqueue a pipeline run after confirming

gbif_from_inaturalist.title: Gbif From Inaturalist
gbif_from_inaturalist.description: Subset of the GBIF records that are iNaturalist research-grade observations republished to GBIF (linked by inat_crossref_id)

inaturalist_direct.title: Inaturalist Direct
inaturalist_direct.description: Research-grade observations fetched from iNaturalist and not yet in GBIF

OccurrenceSources.title: OccurrenceSources
OccurrenceSources.description: How the merged occurrence set was assembled (records are de-duplicated across sources).

scale_ratio.title: Scale Ratio
scale_ratio.description: Median |alternative| / median |primary|; far from 1 suggests a unit mismatch

extrapolation.description: MESS, exDet, MOP, Shape and AOA verdicts (null for models trained before the advanced diagnostics existed)

bioclim_dvc_md5.title: Bioclim Dvc Md5
bioclim_dvc_md5.description: DVC hash of the bioclim version directory (data/bioclim/<v>.dvc)

background.description: Background sampling record; absent for versions trained before it

training_data.description: Exact MaxEnt input (presences + background with predictors); absent for versions trained before snapshots were introduced

occurrence_manifest.description: All valid records considered, with ingested and effective labels

full_resync.title: Full Resync
full_resync.description: Re-fetch all records (not only the delta) and append missing ones

extrapolation.description: This scenario's own MESS < 0 mask (null for legacy projections)

consensus.description: This scenario's own diagnostic-consensus overlay (null for legacy)

diagnostics_land_fraction.title: Diagnostics Land Fraction
diagnostics_land_fraction.description: Share of land flagged by each extrapolation diagnostic

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: consensus of the five diagnostics, or MESS for older models

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Every rule that lowered confidence (empty = high)

confidence_low_extrapolated.title: Confidence Low Extrapolated
confidence_low_extrapolated.description: Low confidence above this share of the candidate zone flagged by ≥ 3 of the 5 extrapolation diagnostics (MESS share for models without them)

confidence_moderate_extrapolated.title: Confidence Moderate Extrapolated
confidence_moderate_extrapolated.description: Moderate confidence above this extrapolated share

confidence_min_analog.title: Confidence Min Analog
confidence_min_analog.description: Moderate confidence below this share of the candidate zone flagged by no diagnostic

confidence_max_mess_extrapolated.title: Confidence Max Mess Extrapolated
confidence_max_mess_extrapolated.description: MESS cap: at most moderate confidence above this share of the candidate zone with MESS < 0

confidence_min_cbi.title: Confidence Min Cbi
confidence_min_cbi.description: CBI floor: at most moderate confidence below this spatial-CV CBI

SpeciesStatus.title: SpeciesStatus
SpeciesStatus.description: Lifecycle state surfaced to the frontend as status badges.

taxon_key.title: Taxon Key
taxon_key.description: GBIF key of the target group (e.g. the species' order)

n_records.title: N Records
n_records.description: GBIF records of the target group in the region

query.title: Query
query.description: GBIF map API density-tile query used as sampling effort

path.title: Path
path.description: Artifact path, relative to the artifact root

TrainingSnapshotInfo.title: TrainingSnapshotInfo
TrainingSnapshotInfo.description: A per-version, content-addressed data file (see training_snapshot.py).

train.title: Train
train.description: Ingest/train reference species that lack a model

tile_url.title: Tile Url
tile_url.description: MVT XYZ template; extra query params may be appended
